first_secret.text: Lan presses a dew-grass shoot into your palm. "You pick gently. Most do not." She lowers her voice. "The Herb Valley, at first light. Nobody else gets there before the dew dries."

greet.text: Careful where you step, those are Dew Grass shoots. I'm Lan. I've gathered in this forest for twenty years.

choices.label: Where do the best herbs grow?
Help her gather for a week.
Ask her to share her secret valley.
Ask if she needs anything fetched.
Bring the five Qi Condensing Grass Lan asked for.
Ask why she keeps watching your hands.
Lan, I have no method at all. Could you teach me to cultivate?
I am new to all this. Where should I begin?

herbs.text: The Herb Patch by the trail is safe enough. The valley to the south hides older roots. Up on Azure Peak, frost flowers grow on the ledges, if the beasts let you live.

help.text: You've a good eye. Here, take a share.

wolves.text: They hunt in the mist. A mortal won't see them coming, so don't wander the deep woods until you can sense qi.

secret.text: Hush. Follow me. Few have seen this place. The ginseng here is older than the village.

teach_breathing.text: Hm. You hold your breath like a child holding a coin. Sit on the root. In through the nose, down to the belly, and let the forest's air do the lifting. The Basic Breathing Method. Every herb-picker I know began with it, and it kept my knees young.

begin.text: Begin with the breath, then the stones. Gather herbs on the forest paths, sell them to the broker at the market, and go home before dusk. Mist wolves do not care how clever you are. Sit when you are tired; qi comes to those who stop chasing it.

errand_ask.text: My knees do not climb the ledges like they used to. Five stalks of Qi Condensing Grass from the Herb Patch, uncrushed and with the roots, and I will pay you properly.

errand_thanks.text: Roots and all, and not a bruise on them. You have a gatherer's hands. Here, seventy stones, and no haggling.
